hypotheses.subject: legacy-checkout-fallback
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag `legacy-checkout-fallback` was flipped from on to off at 2026-09-16T15:14:00Z. With the legacy fallback disabled, account-page requests hit the new spend-summary code path, which raised ZeroDivisionError at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:32, driving error rate from ~1% to 34%.

supporting_evidence.claim: 2026-09-16T15:14:00Z ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:32
error_rate jumps from 0.005 at 15:13 to 0.155 at 15:14 and 0.29 at 15:15, rising to 0.34, with request_volume flat at 1200
Before the toggle the only errors were low-rate 'UpstreamTimeout: payment authorization timed out'; the ZeroDivisionError signature appears only from 15:14 onward
Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-09-15T15:14:00Z to 2026-09-16T15:14:00Z: (nothing changed in this window)

hypotheses.summary: Alternatively, the latent divide-by-zero bug in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py was introduced by an earlier code change and only became reachable when the flag ramp exposed it; no deploy is recorded in the 24h before onset, so this remains unsupported by the change log.
